photo.answer: Ensure good lighting, focus on affected leaves, and keep the camera steady for clear images.

quickTips.tip2: Capture multiple angles of affected leaves

early_blight.name: Early Blight
early_blight.description: A fungal disease that affects leaves, stems, and fruits of tomato plants
symptoms: Dark brown spots on older leaves
Yellowing and browning of leaf edges

longTerm: Remove plant debris at season end

prevention: Water at the base of plants

late_blight.name: Late Blight
late_blight.description: A destructive fungal disease affecting leaves, stems, and fruits
symptoms: Greasy-looking dark green or gray lesions
White fungal growth on underside of leaves

healthy.name: Healthy
healthy.description: Your tomato plant shows no signs of disease

leaf_mold.name: Leaf Mold
leaf_mold.description: A fungal disease that thrives in humid conditions
symptoms: Pale green spots on upper leaf surface

septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
septoria_leaf_spot.description: Fungal disease causing small dark spots on leaves
symptoms: Small dark brown spots on leaves
prevention: Remove lower leaves that touch soil

tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Tomato Mosaic Virus
tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Viral disease causing mottling and leaf distortion in tomatoes
symptoms: Mottled light and dark green patterns on leaves
Leaf distortion and reduced leaf size

immediate: Avoid working with plants when wet

prevention: Wash hands and tools before handling plants

tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.description: Whitefly-transmitted virus causing leaf curling and yellowing

longTerm: Use yellow sticky traps to monitor

target_spot.name: Target Spot
target_spot.description: Fungal disease causing concentric ring lesions on leaves and fruit
prevention: Water at the base of plants

spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_mites.name: Two-spotted Spider Mites
spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_mites.description: Pest infestation causing stippling and webbing on leaves

longTerm: Maintain plant health to reduce stress

bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial Spot
bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing leaf spots and fruit blemishes
symptoms: Darkening and tearing of leaf tissue
